gloss: to become accustomed to seeing; to get used to seeing

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見慣|みな}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become accustomed to seeing; to get used to seeing
definitions.explanation: to no longer find something unusual or striking after seeing it many times

examples.japanese: {見慣|みな}れた⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{見慣|みな}れてきた。
examples.english: I've gotten used to seeing this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見慣|みな}れてしまった。
examples.english: At first I was surprised, but after seeing it every day, I got used to it.

notes:
{見慣|みな}れる is a compound verb combining ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) + ⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧ (to become accustomed), meaning to become accustomed to seeing something.

VERB TYPE: Ichidan verb (ru-verb), intransitive

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見慣|みな}れた + noun (familiar ~): {見慣|みな}れた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (familiar face)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見慣|みな}れる (to get used to seeing ~)
- {見慣|みな}れない + noun (unfamiliar ~): {見慣|みな}れない⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (unfamiliar person)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{聞|き}き{慣|な}れる→聞き慣れる：17602_kikinareru⟧ (to get used to hearing)
- ⟦{食|た}べ{慣|な}れる→食べ慣れる：08505_tabenareru⟧ (to get used to eating)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{慣|な}れる→使い慣れる：07877_tsukainareru⟧ (to get used to using)
